To discriminate M3 from monomeric mechanisms:
- Very high [cat] concentration: M3 rate scales super-linearly with [cat]
- Very low [cat]: M3 rate scales with [cat]^2, so much slower

To discriminate M20 (two deactivations) from M14/M11:
- Need conditions where cat and catS have different populations
